layouts.import_card_solution: Directly solves problem statement: Centered at top, sleek tabbed input for [YouTube URL] and [Upload Local], clip duration toggle [30s | 60s | Automático], embedded credit notice badge ('Custa 3 créditos • Reembolso automático se falhar') INSIDE the card body next to primary button so it takes ZERO extra vertical pushdown, no middle blank space

accessibility.data_testid_policy: All interactive inputs, buttons, score badges, status pills, and action items must carry kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='input-youtube-url', data-testid='btn-extrair-cortes', data-testid='badge-creditos-header', data-testid='btn-excluir-corte', data-testid='btn-refazer-corte', data-testid='btn-cancelar-processamento', data-testid='btn-copiar-hashtags', data-testid='btn-download-mp4')

instructions_to_main_agent: Language & Locale: Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR) throughout all screens, labels, toasts, and error messages.

Solve UI Layout Bugs explicitly: Eliminate middle blank space. Position 'Novo Projeto' container centered and at the very top of the Dashboard. Integrate the credit indicator (e.g. '3 créditos • Saldo: 50') right inside the action zone of the form without breaking or expanding vertical rhythm.
Clip Card Actions: Each generated clip card MUST contain functional explicit buttons: [Excluir], [Refazer], [Cancelar Processamento] (when processing), [Copiar Hashtags], and [Download MP4].
Viral Score Component: Render a prominent circular or badge gauge (0-100) with color coding (Green 80-100 Viral, Amber 60-79 Promissor, Purple <60 Regular), plus AI Hook and magnetic title.
DB / Empty State: No hardcoded fake clips array in frontend. Load exclusively from DB. When empty, render a modern, helpful empty state card with guidance.
Credit Mechanics: New users get 50 credits. Processing costs 3 credits. If backend simulation or processing fails, refund 3 credits with clear toast feedback.
Conexões Page: Test AssemblyAI, Shotstack, and OpenAI API keys with real-time test button & latency indicators. If keys are missing or invalid, display a sleek 'Modo Simulação Ativo' badge.
Format 9:16: All video preview players and thumbnail cards must use strict vertical aspect-ratio (aspect-[9/16]) with overlay subtitles preview option (Hormozi style / Minimalist).
